limitations: Synthetic offered workload only; procedural holdout of two draws from one public generator with public seeds; not OOD/generalization and not an Azure or real-trace holdout.
Protocol values are Mayor choices, not capacity, accuracy or an MPC-favouring design; realized counts 88/104 are outcomes of the frozen seeds and were not tuned or resampled.
With about 100 offers per 5 s tape, TTFT p95/p99 from one replay rest on the top few observations and carry large sampling uncertainty; any p99 claim needs that stated.
Requested prompt-length classes are labels: real chat-template counts (synthetic_prompt should hit them exactly or raise) and gateway cost are unmeasured here.
Prefix-cache-disabled is a requirement for later GPU runs, unverified by this CPU component.
Ties in arrival offsets are possible (zero or sub-nanosecond gaps) and are allowed by the replay schema; class mapping bias <= 2^-64.
CPU-only tests; no tokenizer, GPU, network or native-client validation.
